about.title: No te
about.intro: {project} e tu'atu'a no te au'akaaere mua peer-to-peer tu'angaanga pepa, i akamatatia ki runga i te tekinolotia decentralized ou. Te akakapiti nei i tetai interface māmā ma tetai apinga decentralized atoatoa, te akapapaanga i te tu'angaanga pepa kia kore e kino e kia tau, kare e mou apinga taokotai. Te tarere nei te porotieki i te open source, i tukutukuia i raro i te {license}.

decentralized.title: Network decentralized atoatoa
decentralized.description: Kare e server taokotai, kare e ngai okotai te ka tarevake. Te kitea ana e te tāngata e te iki maira i te tu'atu'a tika atu mei te tāngata anake, kare e tauturuia e te index taokotai, te tracker, e te database.

accessControl.title: Te akapapaanga ririnui o te tomo'anga
accessControl.description: Te ka rauka i te tāngata katoatoa i te akamatatia tana uaorai network ma tana uaorai au ture, kare e moni. I roto i tetai ua atu network, te akamataia e te au tu'anga o te tāngata: te rangatira, te tūtara, te tāngata akakite, te moderator, e te tāngata aru. Ka rauka iaau i te akapapaanga ririnui no runga i te koai te ka rauka i te akakite, i te akamatakite e i te iki mai i te tu'atu'a.

ui.title: Tetai interface meitaki o te tāngata
ui.description: Tetai interface mā e te akatika viviki o te media center, i akamatatia no te au'akaaere o te kāpene, te televīoni, e te au'akaaere kuru. Māmā te aaka i te keyboard, te ratona, te gamepad, e te akakite kuru. Ka rauka i te au tāngata pakari i te akarukea i te software ei headless server o te tu'atu'a kia rouia te command-line interface.

dataFormat.title: Te ariu o te tu'atu'a ka rauka i te tāngata i te tatau
dataFormat.description: Te ariu LISH o te tu'atu'a, i akamatatia ki runga i te JSON, te akamāmā nei i te akamataanga, te tatau, e te marama. Tu'angaanga ki to'ou tu'atu'a ki te au metadata māmā e te tika, ka rauka i te tāngata katoatoa i te akirikiri.

security.title: Te akamouanga e te akarava
security.description: Te au tuatua atu peer-to-peer i akahuriia, ka noo i to'ou tu'atu'a ei mou i te tukutuku. Ka rauka i te tāngata i te taparu i muri i tetai VPN no te akarava maata atu. Te akamou nei {project} i to'ou akamouanga mei tona akamataanga.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Ka rauka te software no te Windows, Linux, e te macOS. Akarukea ki tetai ua atu platform e ana koe.

download.title: Iki mai
download.description: Rave i te {project} no to'ou platform. Te au mea i iki maira, e mea kore moni e te open source.
